title: Guidelines for Doctors' Communication of Information to Patient's Family
what_it_is: Guidelines for Doctors' Communication of Information to Patient's Family

sections.label: SMC action against doctor
sections.summary: Question asks whether Ministry will review mitigating factors, how the SMC ruling affects urgent telephone transmission of information, and whether clearer guidelines will be drawn.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lim Wee Kiak
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Health in respect of the Singapore Medical Council's (SMC's) action against a doctor for breaching patient confidentiality (a) whether the Ministry will review the mitigating factors in the case; (b) how will this SMC ruling impact on any urgent need for doctors to transmit information over the telephone to their patients or their caregivers; and (c) whether the Ministry will be drawing clearer guidelines for the medical profession to comply with.
